- When sentiment is strongly positive (≥ 0.77) in recent days, model tends to overestimate prices; reduce forecast slightly.
- When sentiment is strongly negative (≤ -0.70), model underestimates; adjust upward, especially if recent price is rising.
- Model often overshoots after sharp price spikes (e.g., +5+ points in 1–2 days); cap forecast at +3–4 points above recent peak.
- Mean reversion bias: if 3–5 consecutive days show downward trend, model may lag; forecast should align with recent low before rebound.
- For 30-day horizon, model frequently misses late-period momentum; add 1–2 days of sentiment-driven adjustment at end of forecast.
- If sentiment history shows alternating bullish/bearish cycles, model tends to lag in direction; align forecast with sentiment swing midpoint.
